name: statusline-band
description: Colored band above the prompt: model and effort, git (with its diff and an operation under way), a folder menu, a settings menu, context, 5h/7d usage windows (or cost on an API account), prompt cache countdown and threshold toasts

git.title: Band: git
git.description: full: branch, files changed (a click shows the diff), ahead/behind, an operation under way. branch: the branch and an operation under way. off: the folder alone

usage.title: Band: usage
usage.description: auto: the 5h/7d rate limits on a subscription, the cost on an API account. rate-limits or cost: always that one. off: neither

cache.title: Band: prompt cache
cache.description: ask: the countdown, and a prompt over a cold cache is held with a question. warn: the countdown and a toast. off: neither

toasts.title: Band: toasts
toasts.description: Context and rate-limit thresholds. critical: only the red ones
